name: plugin-kit
description: Shared widgets for Claude Code mods: other plugins hand $.kit their state and draw what it returns.

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: How widgets draw bars, segments and bullets in every plugin that uses the kit: unicode shapes, or plain ascii.

barWidth.title: Meter width
barWidth.description: Cells in a meter's bar, unless the plugin drawing it asks for another width.

listLimit.title: List length
listLimit.description: Items a list shows before folding the rest behind a button, unless the plugin drawing it asks otherwise.
